notes.title: Announcement of the Release of Cozy Dash
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that Cozy Dash will officially be released tomorrow, March 7th! 🎉

In this brand new adventure game, you will join adorable characters on a thrilling journey full of challenges and surprises! Whether it’s solving puzzles, competing, or exploring unknown worlds, it will bring you endless fun and a fresh experience!

Stay tuned and join us in welcoming the arrival of Cozy Dash on March 7th! 🚀

Wishing you an enjoyable gaming experience—come join us!
